title: FREE early access to a CAD generator that works through MCP.
author: Objify
selftext:
I cofounded Objify ( a 3d model generator ) over a year and a half ago and on Sunday, we launched the application. However, the **MCP** is not yet released to the public. I don't want to bore you with the details, but I do want to present you with a mutually beneficial offer.

Basically, I need testers and you need a **free** cad/3d generator for your games. The obvious solution is for Objify to provide many of you with free pro accounts. So lets do it then. I will provide a substantial amount of **premium accounts** you guys and in return I get a bit of feedback/review etc.   


**Comment below if you want to be on our list for testers** and I will reach out to you very soon.

comments.author: justme9974
comments.body: Sure, I'm interested.  How does this compare to something like Meshy or Tripo?

replies.author: Objify
replies.body:
In my opinion, the models that meshy makes are flashy but are filled with a lot of holes in the mesh. Tripo is better, but as far as I know, pretty expensive.   
Our main focuses for Objify are that the models are great quality and also have a great look. So we want the quality of Tripo and the looks of Meshy but with a super cheap price (free for you guys). 

Hope that answers your question.

I will dm soon in regards to you testing for us.

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body:
Can it do real cad? Can I give it a pile of measurements and have it design an actual part in a standard cad file?

Kind of odd advertising it for both modeling and cad, definitely makes me doubt how serious the cad side is.

replies.author: Objify
replies.body:
https://i.redd.it/xefjxg2yn94i1.png

Honestly we are more focused on the CAD then the mesh stuff.  
We are trying to get it to be able to do parametric modeling in a detailed way so that it can create working gears etc.   
Here is an image of a  quick one prompt model testing our gears.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: Interesting. I have a bunch of real world data from previous cad projects. Would be interesting to see how your system would handle them. What is the interface for interacting with it?  Is it simple prompting?

replies.author: Objify
replies.body:
The interface is super simple. It genuinely couldn't be simpler. You don't have to handle any api keys or use the terminal etc. 

What do you mean by real world data?

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body:
Right, but if I'm working in cad dat to day and I want to make a part I'm going to have all sorts of requirements, measurements, previous drawings or sketches, photographs. How do I communicate those to the model?

I have all of the things like this from previous projects. That's what I mean by real world data.  Feel free to DM if you want specifics.

replies.author: Objify
replies.body: Well, it's a chat interface, so in the application you can upload images and files etc, or you can connect Objify to claude/gpt via MCP and then share the info from there.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: Can it intelligently injest the info or is it up to the model to turn the info into a series of 3d editing commands?

replies.author: Objify
replies.body: If I correctly understand the question, it can injest the info intelligentely.
